fact: By ordinance no. 11/2026 of 16 April 2026 the Supreme Court declared inadmissible a request to obtain the political funds figures under law 2025-15, because the CONAI had not first been seized.
title: Ordonnance n°11/2026 de la Cour suprême du Sénégal – Rejet d'une requête en référé pour communication des fonds politiques (2025-2026)
